content: Specific volume is defined as the volume occupied by a unit mass of a given material. It is mathematically equivalent to the reciprocal of the material's density. Specific volume can be represented in units such as cubic meters per kilogram (( frac{m^3}{kg} )), cubic feet per pound-mass (( frac{ft^3}{lbm} )), or milliliters per gram (( frac{mL}{g} )). In this context, ( V ) represents the volume, ( m ) denotes the mass, and ( rho ) symbolizes the density of the material.
